readme.section: 🗂️ DeepSeek Harness Skills & MCPs 分组管理器
readme.text:
A DSH plugin that groups Skills, filters the model skill catalog, toggles MCP servers independently, and manages everything from a left panel.

---

- **🎯 Skill 分组 / Skill Groups** — 创建/重命名/删除分组,分组可折叠;成员与挑选器均为列表 + 多选,支持搜索过滤后的全选/全不选与批量增删。
- **🧠 注入过滤 / Injection Filtering** — 上下文只注入启用分组中出现的 Skill(并集去重,一次一个);未分组 Skill 默认不注入;切换分组实时刷新目录。
- **🔌 MCP 管理 / MCP Management** — 枚举全部 MCP 服务器(profile 配置 + 用户新增),独立开关;用户新增的 MCP 动态挂载并持久化,重启自动恢复。
- **💾 持久化 / Persistence** — `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/state.json`(原子写),下次会话默认沿用上次分组设置。
- **🖥️ UI** — 对话框左侧分组管理面板(`shell.overlay`)+ 会话头部开关(`conversation.session.header.actions`,带 "Skills&MCPs" 标签)。纯浮动面板,不修改产品布局;面板按 DSH 官方设计语言 token 化重做,带加载 / 错误 / 空状态与键盘焦点反馈。
以下截图来自本地一次性预览实例，示例数据仅用于演示：
```bash

readme.section: 单命令安装(无需其他步骤)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager

readme.section: 重启 web profile 进程后生效(当前 GUI 由 dsh web 提供,重启后刷新页面)
readme.text:
```

> **为什么无需额外步骤?** 宿主半插件零外部包依赖(仅 Node 内置模块与本地模块),`dsh plugin add` 的 `link:` 安装即可直接解析,无需符号链接或构建步骤。

卸载时数据随插件一并删除。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager
```

卸载时 pnpm 会执行包的 `postuninstall` 脚本(`scripts/cleanup.mjs`),删除整个状态目录 `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/`(含 `state.json`),分组与 MCP 配置随插件一同移除。手动删除亦可:`rm -rf ~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager`。

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半插件:状态模型、skill 目录过滤(shadow provider `skill-manager-filter`)、MCP 枚举/restrict/动态挂载(经 loader)、12 个 `manager_*` 工具、RPC 路由 `/plugins/dsh-mcp-skill-manager/rpc` |
| `lib/client.js` | Client 半插件:左侧分组管理面板 + 会话头部开关 |
| `lib/state.js` | 纯状态逻辑(零依赖) |
| `lib/store.js` | 状态存储(原子写 + 序列化写链 + 容错读取) |
| `scripts/cleanup.mjs` | `postuninstall` 清理脚本 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁,把插件行插入宿主组合 |
`manager_groups_list/create/delete/rename/set_enabled/add_skill/remove_skill`、`manager_skills_list`、`manager_mcp_list/toggle/add/remove`。

DSH 0.2.1 起兼容门禁优先读取 `engines.dsh`。本插件声明 **`engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-rc.1"`**（无上限），dsh peer 保持 `>=0.1.7-rc.1`，并已核对：

| DSH 版本 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.5-rc.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.1.7-rc.2 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.2.0-rc.1 | ✅ 实测通过 |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ 兼容门禁 + 52 项测试 |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ 真实 Cordis 探针 52/52 |

> 只列出**实际跑过**的版本；未实测的不列。

v0.3.9 支持 DSH **0.1.5-rc.1+**，已在 **0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1** 实测（peer `>=0.1.7-rc.1`，真实 dsh-tools registry 探针通过；0.1.7-rc.2 上 `manager.state.get` RPC 实测返回；0.2.0-rc.1 上通过新的兼容性门禁并正常加载；0.2.1-rc.1 兼容门禁与 52 项测试通过，0.2.1-rc.2 上真实 dsh-tools registry 探针 52/52 通过）；旧版 DSH（0.1.0-rc.x）请使用最后兼容的 npm 版本 **0.3.2**。

readme.text: **A DSH plugin that groups Skills, filters the model skill catalog, toggles MCP servers independently, and manages everything from a left panel**

readme.section: 🗂️ DeepSeek Harness Skills & MCPs Group Manager
readme.text: [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager/releases) [](https://github.com/SeverusZh/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) ---

- **🎯 Skill Groups** — create / rename / delete groups, groups are collapsible; both the member and picker views are list + multi-select, supporting select-all / deselect-all after search filtering and batch add / remove.
- **🧠 Injection Filtering** — the context injects only the Skills that appear in enabled groups (union, deduplicated, one at a time); ungrouped Skills are not injected by default; switching groups refreshes the catalog live.
- **🔌 MCP Management** — enumerate all MCP servers (profile config + user-added) and toggle them independently; user-added MCPs are mounted dynamically and persisted, restored automatically on restart.
- **💾 Persistence** — `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/state.json` (atomic write); the next session reuses the previous group settings by default.
- **🖥️ UI** — a group-management panel on the left of the dialog (`shell.overlay`) + a session-header toggle (`conversation.session.header.actions`, with a "Skills&MCPs" label). A pure floating panel; it does not modify the product layout, and follows the DSH design language with loading / error / empty states and keyboard focus feedback.
The screenshot below comes from a throwaway local preview instance; the example data is for demonstration only:
```bash

readme.section: 单命令安装(无需其他步骤)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager

readme.section: 重启 web profile 进程后生效(当前 GUI 由 dsh web 提供,重启后刷新页面)
readme.text:
```

> **Why no extra steps?** The host half-plugin has zero external package dependencies (only Node built-ins and local modules), so the `link:` install performed by `dsh plugin add` resolves directly — no symlinks or build step needed.

Uninstalling removes the data together with the plugin.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager
```

On uninstall pnpm runs the package's `postuninstall` script (`scripts/cleanup.mjs`), which deletes the entire state directory `~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager/` (including `state.json`), so groups and MCP configuration are removed together with the plugin. Manual removal also works: `rm -rf ~/.dsh/mcp-skill-manager`.

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half-plugin: state model, skill catalog filtering (shadow provider `skill-manager-filter`), MCP enumeration / restrict / dynamic mount (via the loader), 12 `manager_*` tools, RPC route `/plugins/dsh-mcp-skill-manager/rpc` |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half-plugin: left-side group-management panel + session-header toggle |
| `lib/state.js` | Pure state logic (zero dependencies) |
| `lib/store.js` | State storage (atomic write + serialized write chain + fault-tolerant read) |
| `scripts/cleanup.mjs` | `postuninstall` cleanup script |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the plugin line into the host composition |
`manager_groups_list/create/delete/rename/set_enabled/add_skill/remove_skill`, `manager_skills_list`, `manager_mcp_list/toggle/add/remove`.

Since DSH 0.2.1 the compatibility gate prefers `engines.dsh`. This plugin declares **`engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-rc.1"`** (no upper bound), keeps the dsh peers at `>=0.1.7-rc.1`, and has been checked on:

| DSH version | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.5-rc.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.1.7-rc.2 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.2.0-rc.1 | ✅ Tested |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 | ✅ Gate + 52 tests |
| 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ Real-Cordis probes 52/52 |
> Only versions that were **actually run** are listed; untested versions are omitted.

v0.3.9 targets DSH **0.1.5-rc.1+**, verified on **0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.1** (peer `>=0.1.7-rc.1`; the real dsh-tools registry probe passes; on 0.1.7-rc.2 the `manager.state.get` RPC returns as measured; on 0.2.0-rc.1 it passes the new compatibility gate and loads normally; 0.2.1-rc.1 passes the gate and all 52 tests, and 0.2.1-rc.2 passes the real dsh-tools registry probes 52/52); for older DSH releases (0.1.0-rc.x) use the last compatible npm version, **0.3.2**.
